plan:
d = SCAN_TABLE(drivers) -> FILTER(dob > '1994-01-01')
r = SCAN_TABLE(races) -> FILTER(year = 2015)
c = SCAN_TABLE(circuits)
res = SCAN_TABLE(results)
rc = JOIN(left=r, right=c, on r.circuitId = c.circuitId)
x = JOIN(left=res, right=rc, on res.raceId = rc.raceId)
JOIN(left=d, right=x, on d.driverId = x.driverId) -> DISTINCT(driverId, forename, surname, nationality, country) -> SEM_FILTER("the circuit country is the home country of a driver with this nationality") -> DISTINCT(forename, surname)
basis: drivers.dob/races.year 为确定性过滤，经 results 连接 races、circuits；唯一语义步是 SEM_FILTER 判断 circuits.country 是否为 drivers.nationality 对应的祖国（库中只有国籍形容词，无国家映射），在去重后的(车手,国家)对上执行。

plan:
r = SCAN_TABLE(races) -> FILTER(year = 2015)
cr = SCAN_TABLE(constructorResults)
k = SCAN_TABLE(constructors)
p = JOIN(left=cr, right=r, on cr.raceId = r.raceId)
part = JOIN(left=k, right=p, on k.constructorId = p.constructorId) -> DISTINCT(constructorId, name, nationality)
cc = SCAN_TABLE(circuits) -> DISTINCT(country)
SEM_JOIN(left=part, right=cc, "the constructor's nationality corresponds to the circuit country") -> DISTINCT(constructorId) -> AGGREGATE(COUNT(constructorId) AS n)
basis: 2015 年参赛车队由 constructorResults+races(year=2015) 确定；SEM_JOIN 将 constructors.nationality（形容词）与 circuits 的去重国家匹配，属世界知识。歧义：赛道范围取整张 circuits 表（含历史赛道）而非仅 2015 年赛历，按 gold=10 推断前者。

plan:
p = SCAN_TABLE(posts) -> SORT(ViewCount DESC) -> LIMIT(10)
t = SCAN_TABLE(tags) -> SORT(Count DESC) -> LIMIT(3)
SEM_JOIN(left=p, right=t, "the post Title is closely related to the tag name TagName") -> DISTINCT(Id) -> AGGREGATE(COUNT(Id) AS n)
basis: posts.ViewCount 取前 10、tags.Count 取前 3 为确定性步骤；标题与标签名的语义相关性用 SEM_JOIN（文本理解），按帖子去重后计数。

plan:
p = SCAN_TABLE(posts) -> SORT(ViewCount DESC) -> LIMIT(10)
c = SCAN_TABLE(comments) -> SORT(Score DESC) -> LIMIT(10)
SEM_JOIN(left=p, right=c, "the post (Title and Body) is relevant to the content of the comment Text") -> DISTINCT(Id) -> PROJECT(Id)
basis: popular 按 posts.ViewCount（schema 注释称其表示热度），comments.Score 取前 10；帖子与评论内容相关性为 SEM_JOIN，按 posts.Id 去重输出。歧义：是否与评论自身所属帖子无关，此处按内容相关处理。

plan:
c = SCAN_TABLE(comments) -> SORT(Score DESC) -> LIMIT(5)
t = SCAN_TABLE(tags) -> FILTER(TagName LIKE 'm%')
SEM_JOIN(left=c, right=t, "the comment Text contains a phrase similar to the tag name TagName") -> DISTINCT(Id) -> PROJECT(Id)
basis: comments.Score 前 5、tags.TagName 以 M 开头（标签为小写，用 LIKE 'm%'）为确定性步骤；评论文本含与标签名相似短语的判断为 SEM_JOIN，输出 comments.Id。

plan:
p = SCAN_TABLE(posts) -> SORT(Score DESC) -> LIMIT(20)
b = SCAN_TABLE(badges) -> DISTINCT(Name) -> SORT(Name DESC) -> LIMIT(10)
SEM_JOIN(left=p, right=b, "the displayed post content (Title and Body) is similar to the badge Name") -> DISTINCT(Id) -> AGGREGATE(COUNT(Id) AS n)
basis: posts.Score 前 20、badges.Name 去重后按字母降序取前 10 为确定性；帖子展示内容与徽章名相似为 SEM_JOIN，再按帖子计数。歧义：display content 取 Title+Body；徽章名是否先去重未说明，此处去重。

plan:
l = SCAN_TABLE(League)
c = SCAN_TABLE(Country)
SEM_JOIN(left=l, right=c, "the league name contains or is similar to the country name") -> DISTINCT(l.name) -> PROJECT(l.name)
basis: League.name 与 Country.name 的相似性用 SEM_JOIN（名称语义/字符串相似），输出联赛名。歧义：country name 可理解为任意国家（则改为对 League 做 SEM_FILTER），此处用库内 Country 表。

plan: SCAN_TABLE(Team) -> SORT(team_long_name ASC) -> LIMIT(10) -> SEM_MAP("the country name the team name most closely resembles or is associated with, or NULL if none" AS similar_country) -> FILTER(similar_country IS NOT NULL) -> PROJECT(team_long_name, similar_country)
basis: Team.team_long_name 字母序前 10 为确定性；判断队名是否像某国名并给出最相似国家需要世界知识（如 Nürnberg→Germany），用 SEM_MAP 生成 similar_country 后过滤空值。歧义：国家范围为任意国家而非仅 Country 表。

plan:
h = SCAN_TABLE(superhero) -> SORT(superhero_name ASC) -> LIMIT(5)
sp = SCAN_TABLE(superpower)
SEM_JOIN(left=h, right=sp, "the superhero name is closely relevant to the superpower power_name") -> DISTINCT(superhero_name) -> PROJECT(superhero_name)
basis: superhero.superhero_name 字母序前 5 为确定性；名字与 superpower.power_name 的语义相关性为 SEM_JOIN，按英雄名去重。

plan:
a = SCAN_TABLE(attribute)
sp = SCAN_TABLE(superpower)
rel = SEM_JOIN(left=a, right=sp, "the attribute name closely relates to the superpower power_name") -> DISTINCT(a.id)
ha = SCAN_TABLE(hero_attribute)
JOIN(left=ha, right=rel, on ha.attribute_id = rel.id) -> AGGREGATE(COUNT(DISTINCT hero_id) AS n)
basis: 语义判断放在粒度最粗的 attribute×superpower 上（SEM_JOIN，attribute 仅少量行），得到相关属性后经 hero_attribute 确定性连接并计数去重的 hero_id。歧义：也可理解为英雄自身属性与其自身超能力相关（需再连 hero_power）。

plan:
r = SCAN_TABLE(races) -> FILTER(year = 2016)
c = SCAN_TABLE(circuits)
JOIN(left=r, right=c, on r.circuitId = c.circuitId) -> DISTINCT(circuitId, country) -> SEM_CLASSIFY(country, ["Asia", "Europe", "North America", "South America", "Africa", "Oceania"] AS continent) -> AGGREGATE(continent; COUNT(circuitId) AS n)
basis: races(year=2016)+circuits 确定性取得 2016 赛道；circuits 无大洲列，用 SEM_CLASSIFY 由 country 判定大洲，再按大洲计数。

plan:
c = SCAN_TABLE(circuits) -> SEM_FILTER("the circuit country is located in Asia")
r = SCAN_TABLE(races) -> FILTER(year = 2016)
rc = JOIN(left=r, right=c, on r.circuitId = c.circuitId)
res = SCAN_TABLE(results)
x = JOIN(left=res, right=rc, on res.raceId = rc.raceId)
d = SCAN_TABLE(drivers) -> FILTER(dob >= '1997-01-01')
JOIN(left=d, right=x, on d.driverId = x.driverId) -> DISTINCT(forename, surname) -> PROJECT(forename, surname)
basis: 是否位于亚洲在 circuits 层用 SEM_FILTER（无大洲列）；Gen-Z 按常用定义 1997 年起出生，作为常量写入 drivers.dob 确定性过滤（定义本身属常识，可能有 1995/1996 起的分歧）。

plan:
r = SCAN_TABLE(races) -> FILTER(year > 2008)
res = SCAN_TABLE(results)
rr = JOIN(left=res, right=r, on res.raceId = r.raceId)
d = SCAN_TABLE(drivers)
dd = JOIN(left=d, right=rr, on d.driverId = rr.driverId) -> DISTINCT(driverId, nationality)
n = SCAN_TABLE(drivers) -> DISTINCT(nationality) -> SEM_CLASSIFY(nationality, ["Asia", "Europe", "North America", "South America", "Africa", "Oceania"] AS continent)
JOIN(left=dd, right=n, on dd.nationality = n.nationality) -> AGGREGATE(continent; COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) AS n)
basis: 北京奥运=2008 年这一常识作为常量写入 races.year > 2008；车手所属大洲由 drivers.nationality 推断，用 SEM_CLASSIFY 在去重国籍上执行后连回，再按大洲统计去重车手数。

plan:
r = SCAN_TABLE(races) -> FILTER(date > '2017-01-20')
c = SCAN_TABLE(circuits)
JOIN(left=r, right=c, on r.circuitId = c.circuitId) -> DISTINCT(circuitId, name, location, country, lat, lng, alt) -> SEM_FILTER("the circuit location is a coastal city") -> SEM_AGG("summarize the common characteristics of these circuits")
basis: 奥巴马第二任期于 2017-01-20 结束，作为常量过滤 races.date；circuits.location 是否沿海城市需地理知识用 SEM_FILTER（在去重赛道上），最后 SEM_AGG 汇总赛道特征。

plan:
sp = SCAN_TABLE(superpower) -> SEM_FILTER("the power is related to healing or recovery")
hp = SCAN_TABLE(hero_power)
hps = JOIN(left=hp, right=sp, on hp.power_id = sp.id)
g = SCAN_TABLE(gender) -> FILTER(gender = 'Male')
pub = SCAN_TABLE(publisher) -> FILTER(publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')
h = SCAN_TABLE(superhero)
hg = JOIN(left=h, right=g, on h.gender_id = g.id)
hgp = JOIN(left=hg, right=pub, on hg.publisher_id = pub.id)
JOIN(left=hgp, right=hps, on hgp.id = hps.hero_id) -> AGGREGATE(COUNT(DISTINCT hgp.id) AS n)
basis: 性别、出版商为 gender/publisher 表上的确定性过滤；超能力是否与治愈/恢复相关用 SEM_FILTER 作用于 superpower 表（最粗粒度），经 hero_power 连接后计数去重英雄。

plan:
c = SCAN_TABLE(Country) -> SEM_FILTER("the country is landlocked (inland, no sea coast)")
m = SCAN_TABLE(Match) -> FILTER(CAST(strftime('%m', date) AS INTEGER) IN (6, 7, 8))
JOIN(left=m, right=c, on m.country_id = c.id) -> AGGREGATE(COUNT(m.id) AS n)
basis: 内陆国判断需地理知识，在 Country 表上 SEM_FILTER；夏季按北半球 6-8 月对 Match.date 确定性过滤（夏季月份定义为常识常量，存在 6-9 月等歧义），连接后计数。

plan:
p = SCAN_TABLE(Player) -> FILTER(birthday >= '1955-11-01' AND birthday <= '1975-04-30')
pa = SCAN_TABLE(Player_Attributes)
JOIN(left=p, right=pa, on p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id) -> AGGREGATE(player_api_id, player_name; AVG(finishing) AS finishing, AVG(shot_power) AS shot_power, AVG(volleys) AS volleys, AVG(long_shots) AS long_shots, AVG(positioning) AS positioning, AVG(dribbling) AS dribbling) -> SEM_FILTER("the player is good at attacking based on these attacking skill ratings") -> PROJECT(player_name)
basis: 越战时间 1955-11-01 至 1975-04-30 为常识常量，对 Player.birthday 确定性过滤；good at attacking 无库内定义，按球员聚合 Player_Attributes 进攻类属性后用 SEM_FILTER 判断。歧义：也可用 attacking_work_rate='high' 或某数值阈值替代。

plan:
col = SCAN_TABLE(colour) -> FILTER(colour = 'Grey')
pub = SCAN_TABLE(publisher) -> FILTER(publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')
sp = SCAN_TABLE(superpower) -> SEM_FILTER("the power allows travelling across time")
hp = SCAN_TABLE(hero_power)
hps = JOIN(left=hp, right=sp, on hp.power_id = sp.id)
h = SCAN_TABLE(superhero)
he = JOIN(left=h, right=col, on h.eye_colour_id = col.id)
hep = JOIN(left=he, right=pub, on he.publisher_id = pub.id)
JOIN(left=hep, right=hps, on hep.id = hps.hero_id) -> DISTINCT(superhero_name) -> PROJECT(superhero_name)
basis: 眼睛颜色(colour 经 eye_colour_id)、出版商为确定性过滤；能否穿越时间在 superpower 表上用 SEM_FILTER 判断（可能匹配 Time Travel 等多项能力名），再经 hero_power 连接。

plan:
col = SCAN_TABLE(colour) -> SEM_FILTER("the colour resembles a typical East Asian skin appearance")
h = SCAN_TABLE(superhero)
hc = JOIN(left=h, right=col, on h.skin_colour_id = col.id)
hp = SCAN_TABLE(hero_power)
JOIN(left=hc, right=hp, on hc.id = hp.hero_id) -> AGGREGATE(COUNT(DISTINCT power_id) AS n)
basis: Asian like color 需常识判断，在 colour 表上 SEM_FILTER，并假定指肤色（superhero.skin_colour_id）；之后经 hero_power 统计去重 power_id。歧义：也可能包括发色/眼色。

plan: SCAN_TABLE(satscores) -> FILTER(rtype = 'S') -> COMPUTE(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite AS total) -> SORT(total DESC) -> LIMIT(10) -> SEM_FILTER("the school name sname is named after a person (contains a human name)") -> PROJECT(sname)
basis: satscores 学校级(rtype='S')三科平均分之和排序取前 10 为确定性；校名是否以人名命名需文本理解，用 SEM_FILTER 作用于 sname。

plan:
cty = SCAN_TABLE(schools) -> DISTINCT(County) -> SEM_FILTER("the county has a population over 2 million")
s = SCAN_TABLE(schools) -> FILTER(OpenDate <= date('now', '-100 years'))
JOIN(left=s, right=cty, on s.County = cty.County) -> AGGREGATE(COUNT(CDSCode) AS n)
basis: 开办超过 100 年由 schools.OpenDate 相对当前日期确定性过滤；县人口不在库中，在去重 County 上用 SEM_FILTER。歧义：参照日期（当前或数据年份）及是否仅计 Active 学校未说明。

plan:
r = SCAN_TABLE(races) -> FILTER(name = 'Singapore Grand Prix')
res = SCAN_TABLE(results)
rr = JOIN(left=res, right=r, on res.raceId = r.raceId)
d = SCAN_TABLE(drivers)
JOIN(left=d, right=rr, on d.driverId = rr.driverId) -> COMPUTE((julianday(date) - julianday(dob)) / 365.25 AS age_at_race) -> FILTER(age_at_race > 42) -> DISTINCT(forename, surname) -> PROJECT(forename, surname)
basis: 全部确定性：races.name 过滤新加坡大奖赛，经 results 连 drivers，用 races.date 与 drivers.dob 计算比赛时年龄并过滤 >42；无需语义算子。

plan:
r = SCAN_TABLE(races) -> FILTER(year = 2009 AND name = 'European Grand Prix')
res = SCAN_TABLE(results) -> FILTER(position <= 3)
rr = JOIN(left=res, right=r, on res.raceId = r.raceId)
d = SCAN_TABLE(drivers)
pod = JOIN(left=d, right=rr, on d.driverId = rr.driverId) -> COMPUTE((julianday(date) - julianday(dob)) / 365.25 AS age_at_race) -> FILTER(age_at_race > 25)
lastr = SCAN_TABLE(races) -> AGGREGATE(year; MAX(round) AS last_round)
r2 = SCAN_TABLE(races)
fin = JOIN(left=r2, right=lastr, on r2.year = lastr.year AND r2.round = lastr.last_round)
ds = SCAN_TABLE(driverStandings) -> FILTER(position = 1)
champ = JOIN(left=ds, right=fin, on ds.raceId = fin.raceId)
d2 = SCAN_TABLE(drivers)
cn = JOIN(left=d2, right=champ, on d2.driverId = champ.driverId) -> DISTINCT(nationality)
JOIN(left=pod, right=cn, on pod.nationality = cn.nationality) -> PROJECT(forename, surname, position) -> SORT(position ASC)
basis: 全部确定性：领奖台=results.position<=3，比赛时年龄由 races.date-drivers.dob 计算；产生过世界冠军的国家由每年最后一站 driverStandings.position=1 的车手国籍推得（库中有历年积分榜），以国籍等值连接代替语义判断。若赛季数据不完整则可改为 SEM_FILTER 世界知识。

plan:
cty = SCAN_TABLE(schools) -> DISTINCT(County) -> SEM_FILTER("the county is in Southern California")
s = SCAN_TABLE(schools) -> FILTER(Charter = 1 AND Magnet = 1)
sc = JOIN(left=s, right=cty, on s.County = cty.County)
sat = SCAN_TABLE(satscores)
JOIN(left=sc, right=sat, on sc.CDSCode = sat.cds) -> COMPUTE(ROUND(CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NumTstTakr, 3) AS excellence_rate) -> PROJECT(School, excellence_rate)
basis: Charter/Magnet 为 schools 上确定性过滤；南加州归属需地理知识，在去重 County 上 SEM_FILTER；SAT 优秀率按 satscores.NumGE1500/NumTstTakr 计算并保留三位。

plan:
d = SCAN_TABLE(drivers) -> FILTER(forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton')
c = SCAN_TABLE(circuits) -> SEM_FILTER("the circuit country is located in Asia")
r = SCAN_TABLE(races) -> FILTER(year = 2016)
rc = JOIN(left=r, right=c, on r.circuitId = c.circuitId)
res = SCAN_TABLE(results) -> FILTER(position = 1)
w = JOIN(left=res, right=d, on res.driverId = d.driverId)
wr = JOIN(left=w, right=rc, on w.raceId = rc.raceId)
lt = SCAN_TABLE(lapTimes)
JOIN(left=lt, right=wr, on lt.raceId = wr.raceId AND lt.driverId = wr.driverId) -> AGGREGATE(country; AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_ms)
basis: 车手、年份、获胜(results.position=1)、圈速均值(lapTimes.milliseconds)为确定性；赛道是否位于亚洲用 SEM_FILTER 作用于 circuits。按 circuits.country 分组（gold 以国家为键）。

plan:
d = SCAN_TABLE(drivers) -> FILTER(nationality = 'Indian')
res = SCAN_TABLE(results)
JOIN(left=d, right=res, on d.driverId = res.driverId) -> COMPUTE(CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN points ELSE 0 END AS won_points, CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN 0 ELSE points END AS other_points) -> AGGREGATE(driverId, forename, surname; SUM(points) AS total_points, SUM(won_points) AS won_points, SUM(other_points) AS other_points) -> PROJECT(forename, surname, total_points, won_points, other_points)
basis: 全部确定性：drivers.nationality='Indian'，连 results 用 position=1 区分获胜场次并分别汇总 points；无需语义算子。

plan:
s = SCAN_TABLE(schools) -> FILTER(Virtual IS NOT NULL)
sat = SCAN_TABLE(satscores)
JOIN(left=s, right=sat, on s.CDSCode = sat.cds) -> AGGREGATE(Virtual; ROUND(AVG(AvgScrRead), 2) AS avg_read, ROUND(AVG(AvgScrMath), 2) AS avg_math, ROUND(AVG(AvgScrWrite), 2) AS avg_write) -> SORT(Virtual ASC)
basis: 全部确定性：按 schools.Virtual 类型分组计算 satscores 三科平均分并保留两位；“分析关系”即该分组对比表（gold 为表格），未加 SEM_AGG 叙述。

plan:
cty = SCAN_TABLE(schools) -> DISTINCT(County) -> SEM_CLASSIFY(County, ["Low-Income", "High-Income"] AS income_level)
s = SCAN_TABLE(schools)
sc = JOIN(left=s, right=cty, on s.County = cty.County)
sat = SCAN_TABLE(satscores)
JOIN(left=sc, right=sat, on sc.CDSCode = sat.cds) -> AGGREGATE(income_level; ROUND(AVG(AvgScrRead), 2) AS avg_read, ROUND(AVG(AvgScrMath), 2) AS avg_math, ROUND(AVG(AvgScrWrite), 2) AS avg_write)
basis: 地区收入水平库中无直接列，用 SEM_CLASSIFY 在去重 County 上判定高/低收入，再按类别求 satscores 三科均分。歧义较大：也可用 frpm 免费餐比例阈值定义低收入，或在 City 粒度判定；gold 中高收入分数更低，提示并非 FRPM 定义。

plan:
r = SCAN_TABLE(races) -> FILTER(year = 2016 AND name = 'British Grand Prix')
res = SCAN_TABLE(results)
JOIN(left=res, right=r, on res.raceId = r.raceId) -> COMPUTE(CASE WHEN grid > 10 AND points > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS hit) -> AGGREGATE(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(hit) / COUNT(resultId), 2) AS pct)
basis: 全部确定性：races 定位 2016 英国大奖赛，results.grid>10 且 points>0 计数除以参赛总数。歧义：grid=0（维修区起步）是否算前十之外，此处不算。

plan: SCAN_TABLE(satscores) -> COMPUTE(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite AS total) -> FILTER(total >= 960) -> AGGREGATE(COUNT(cds) AS n)
basis: 新 SAT 满分 1600、60% 即 960 为常识常量，写入确定性过滤；总分取 satscores 三科平均分之和。歧义：数据为旧三科制，是否仅计学校级(rtype='S')未说明，此处不按 rtype 过滤。

plan:
d = SCAN_TABLE(drivers) -> FILTER(forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton')
r = SCAN_TABLE(races) -> FILTER(year IN (2014, 2016))
res = SCAN_TABLE(results)
rr = JOIN(left=res, right=r, on res.raceId = r.raceId)
JOIN(left=d, right=rr, on d.driverId = rr.driverId) -> COMPUTE(CASE WHEN position = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS win, CASE WHEN position <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS podium) -> AGGREGATE(year; COUNT(resultId) AS races, SUM(points) AS points, SUM(win) AS wins, SUM(podium) AS podiums, AVG(positionOrder) AS avg_finish) -> SEM_MAP("write a short description of the driver's performance in this season from the statistics" AS description) -> PROJECT(year, description)
basis: 按赛季汇总 results 中的场次、积分、胜场、领奖台、平均名次为确定性；“描述表现”为生成文本，用 SEM_MAP 对每个赛季汇总行生成描述。

plan: SCAN_TABLE(comments) -> FILTER(Score > 30) -> SEM_MAP("extract the technical terms mentioned in the comment Text" AS technical_terms) -> PROJECT(Id, technical_terms)
basis: comments.Score>30 为确定性过滤；从 Text 抽取技术术语需文本理解，用 SEM_MAP。

plan:
u = SCAN_TABLE(users) -> FILTER(DisplayName = 'rcs')
p = SCAN_TABLE(posts)
JOIN(left=p, right=u, on p.OwnerUserId = u.Id) -> SEM_MAP("identify the technical terms in the post Body and write supplementary explanations for them" AS supplementary) -> PROJECT(p.Id, Body, supplementary)
basis: users.DisplayName='rcs' 并经 posts.OwnerUserId 取帖子为确定性；识别术语并生成补充说明为 SEM_MAP。歧义：post contents 取 Body（也可含 Title）。

plan: SCAN_TABLE(comments) -> FILTER(Score > 40) -> SEM_CLASSIFY(Text, ["Positive", "Negative", "Neutral"] AS stance) -> PROJECT(Id, stance)
basis: comments.Score>40 为确定性过滤；立场三分类用 SEM_CLASSIFY 作用于 Text。

plan: SCAN_TABLE(badges) -> AGGREGATE(Name; COUNT(Id) AS cnt) -> SORT(cnt DESC) -> LIMIT(3) -> SEM_MAP("a more creative version of the badge Name" AS creative_name) -> PROJECT(Name, creative_name)
basis: 徽章热度按 badges 中同名颁发次数统计取前 3 为确定性；改写为更有创意的名称为 SEM_MAP。

plan: SCAN_TABLE(users) -> FILTER(AboutMe IS NOT NULL) -> SORT(DisplayName DESC) -> LIMIT(3) -> SEM_FILTER("the AboutMe text contains contact details such as Twitter, website or email") -> SEM_MAP("extract the contact details from AboutMe" AS contact_details) -> PROJECT(contact_details)
basis: 按 users.DisplayName 字母序取最后 3 位为确定性；判断 AboutMe 是否含联系方式并抽取为 SEM_FILTER+SEM_MAP。歧义：排序键可能是 AboutMe 本身而非 DisplayName，且是否先排除空 AboutMe 未说明。

plan:
c = SCAN_TABLE(Country) -> FILTER(name = 'Spain')
l = SCAN_TABLE(League)
lc = JOIN(left=l, right=c, on l.country_id = c.id)
m = SCAN_TABLE(Match) -> FILTER(season = '2015/2016')
ml = JOIN(left=m, right=lc, on m.league_id = lc.id) -> DISTINCT(home_team_api_id)
t = SCAN_TABLE(Team)
JOIN(left=t, right=ml, on t.team_api_id = ml.home_team_api_id) -> SEM_CLASSIFY(team_long_name, ["TRUE", "FALSE"] AS has_city) -> AGGREGATE(has_city; COUNT(team_api_id) AS n)
basis: 西班牙联赛经 Country/League 连接、Match.season='2015/2016' 取参赛队（主队去重即全部球队）为确定性；队名是否含城市名需地理知识，用 SEM_CLASSIFY 输出 TRUE/FALSE 后计数。

plan:
d = SCAN_TABLE(drivers) -> FILTER(forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton')
r = SCAN_TABLE(races) -> FILTER(year = 2016)
res = SCAN_TABLE(results)
rr = JOIN(left=res, right=r, on res.raceId = r.raceId)
team = JOIN(left=rr, right=d, on rr.driverId = d.driverId) -> DISTINCT(constructorId)
res2 = SCAN_TABLE(results)
r2 = SCAN_TABLE(races) -> FILTER(year = 2016)
rr2 = JOIN(left=res2, right=r2, on res2.raceId = r2.raceId)
mates = JOIN(left=rr2, right=team, on rr2.constructorId = team.constructorId) -> DISTINCT(driverId)
d2 = SCAN_TABLE(drivers) -> FILTER(NOT (forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton'))
JOIN(left=d2, right=mates, on d2.driverId = mates.driverId) -> SEM_MAP("describe the family background of this driver" AS family_background) -> PROJECT(forename, surname, family_background)
basis: 通过 results+races(2016) 确定性找到 Hamilton 所在 constructorId 及同队其他车手；家庭背景不在库中，需外部知识，用 SEM_MAP 生成描述。

plan:
sat = SCAN_TABLE(satscores) -> FILTER(rtype = 'S') -> COMPUTE(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite AS total) -> SORT(total DESC) -> LIMIT(1)
s = SCAN_TABLE(schools)
JOIN(left=sat, right=s, on sat.cds = s.CDSCode) -> COMPUTE(MailStrAbr || ', ' || MailCity || ', ' || MailState || ' ' || MailZip AS mail_address) -> PROJECT(mail_address)
basis: 全部确定性：satscores 三科和最高的学校连 schools，用缩写邮寄地址列 MailStrAbr/MailCity/MailState/MailZip 拼成标准地址（与 gold 格式一致）。若要求改写规范化格式，可将最后的 COMPUTE 换成 SEM_MAP。

plan: SCAN_TABLE(Player) -> SORT(height DESC) -> LIMIT(5) -> SEM_MAP("the country the player name most likely originates from" AS origin_country) -> PROJECT(player_name, origin_country)
basis: highest 理解为身高（Player.height）取前 5 为确定性；姓名来源国需语言/文化知识，用 SEM_MAP。歧义：并列身高时前 5 不唯一，highest 也可能指评分。
